stem: A scout reports 8 affected plants out of 40 this week versus 6 out of 20 last week. Which comparison is most defensible?
choices: Incidence increased because 8 is greater than 6
Incidence decreased from 30% to 20%, but sampling comparability and spatial pattern should still be checked before interpreting the trend
The two rounds cannot be compared under any circumstances
rationale: Raw counts are misleading when sample size changes. Normalized incidence is 30% then 20%; interpretation should still consider route, method, location, severity, and other evidence.
